course_glossary_note: Draft glossary for Lecture 01–03 and Lecture 05 of AIE2026. Replace content once the lecture slides are finalized.
transformations: Wrap each assistant definition in JSON with needs_review=false; prepend the same system instruction used in evaluation.
Add 8 negative training examples about unlisted terms; use disjoint negative terms in validation and test.
Use 12 distinct validation questions and 18 fixed test questions: 6 named terms, 6 paraphrases, 6 unlisted terms.
split_policy: Known concepts are shared across splits; exact and normalized questions are disjoint. This tests wording generalization and coverage handling, not unseen-concept learning.
answering_mode: Closed book. The neural model receives only the shared system instruction and the question, without glossary definitions or gold labels.
coverage_policy: An unlisted term must request review even if its real-world definition is known. This measures compliance with glossary coverage, not global factual ignorance.
retrieval_baseline: Longest whole normalized term/alias match; return the stored definition, or abstain. It is a simple lexical baseline, not semantic retrieval or a full RAG system.
metric_policy: Strict JSON format score; content score checks review flag and case-insensitive keyword groups. Keyword scores require manual semantic review.
training_policy: Fixed three-epoch first experiment; validate once after training, without selecting a checkpoint or tuning against test results.
